strings.setup.title: Set up your farm
strings.setup.welcome.title: Welcome to AgroFlow
strings.setup.welcome.body: Let's get your farm ready. It takes about 10 minutes, and you can stop and carry on later.
strings.setup.welcome.why: Choose the language you read best. You can change it any time in Settings.
strings.setup.welcome.tip: Tap a language and the app changes straight away.
strings.setup.password.title: Set your own password
strings.setup.password.why: Only you should know it. The one you signed in with was a temporary password.
strings.setup.password.already: Your password is already set. You can change it later in Profile.
strings.setup.password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
strings.setup.password.failed: The password could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
strings.setup.password.tip: Pick something only you know, with a number in it.
strings.setup.telegram.title: Link Telegram
strings.setup.telegram.why: Telegram is how AgroFlow sends you alerts, and how you get a new password if you forget yours.
strings.setup.telegram.linked: Telegram is linked. Alerts will reach you there.
strings.setup.telegram.tip: Keep Telegram notifications on, so a dry-zone alert wakes your phone.
strings.setup.zones.title: Your zones
strings.setup.zones.why: AgroFlow works out water for each crop and its age, so check what is growing and when it was planted.
strings.setup.zones.plantedQ: About how long ago did you plant?
strings.setup.zones.none: No zones yet. Your AgroFlow field officer adds them.
strings.setup.zones.tip: Not sure of the date? A rough guess is fine; you can fix it later.
strings.setup.flow.title: Measure your water flow
strings.setup.flow.why: AgroFlow needs to know how fast water comes out, to tell you how many minutes to water.
strings.setup.flow.how: Hold a container under the tap or hose. Press Start as the water goes in, and Stop when it is full.
strings.setup.flow.size: How much does the container hold?
strings.setup.flow.sizeInvalid: Enter how much the container holds (more than 0).
strings.setup.flow.timeInvalid: Time it for more than 2 seconds. Use a bigger container if it fills too fast.
strings.setup.flow.tip: Use any bucket or container. Fill it to a line you know, and type how many litres that is.
strings.setup.soil.title: Teach AgroFlow your soil
strings.setup.soil.why: Every soil holds water differently. Two readings show AgroFlow what dry and wet look like in yours.
strings.setup.soil.noKit: {zone}: waiting for kit. This opens once the kit is connected.
strings.setup.soil.noKits: None of your zones has a kit yet, so there is nothing to do here for now.
strings.setup.soil.dryHow: When the soil is dry, as it is before you water:
strings.setup.soil.wetHow: Water well, wait until tomorrow, then:
strings.setup.soil.reminder: We'll remind you on Home to save the wet reading.
strings.setup.soil.kitOffline: The kit did not answer. You can carry on and do this later.
strings.setup.soil.tip: Do the dry reading before you water.
strings.setup.done.title: All set
strings.setup.done.why: Here is what is done and what is still to do.
strings.setup.card.title: Setup {done}/{total} done
strings.setup.card.wet: Soil: save the wet reading for {zone}
strings.setup.location.title: Is this your farm?
strings.setup.location.why: Your field officer saved where your farm is. AgroFlow uses it for the weather and for alerts from farmers nearby.
strings.setup.location.noPoint: There is no map point for your farm yet. Your field officer can add it.
strings.setup.location.wrong: Something's wrong — tell my field officer
strings.setup.location.sent: Thank you. Your field officer will check your farm's place.
strings.setup.water.title: Where does your water come from?
strings.setup.water.why: If you water from a tank, AgroFlow keeps an eye on how much is left.
strings.setup.tank.title: Your tank
strings.setup.tank.why: With the size and how full it is now, AgroFlow can tell you how many days of water you have left.
strings.setup.tank.ph: Water pH, if you know it (you can leave this)
strings.setup.tank.needSize: Choose how much the tank holds.
strings.setup.tank.needLevel: Choose how full it is now.
strings.setup.tank.badPh: pH is a number from 0 to 14.
strings.setup.irrigation.title: How is {zone} watered?
strings.setup.irrigation.why: Some water is lost on the way to the roots. Drip loses little, a hose or furrow loses more, so AgroFlow adds a little to the amount for the way you water.
strings.setup.soilType.title: What is the soil like in {zone}?
strings.setup.soilType.why: Sandy soil dries out fast and clay holds water long, so AgroFlow waters each a little differently.
strings.setup.soilType.sandyDesc: Feels gritty and falls apart in your hand, even when wet.
strings.setup.soilType.loamDesc: Dark and crumbly. A wet handful holds together, then breaks.
strings.setup.soilType.clayDesc: Sticky when wet, hard and cracked when dry.
strings.setup.size.title: How big is {zone}?
strings.setup.size.why: The size turns the water the crop needs into litres.
strings.setup.size.label: Size
strings.setup.maxRun.title: Longest watering at a time
strings.setup.maxRun.why: The pump never runs longer than this in one go, to keep it safe and stop water running away.
strings.setup.maxRun.ask: Ask your field officer to change this.
strings.setup.alerts.title: Which alerts do you want?
strings.setup.alerts.why: Every alert shows in the app. Choose which ones also come to Telegram.
strings.setup.alerts.noTelegram: Link Telegram to get these on your phone too.
strings.setup.alerts.quietHours: No Telegram messages from {start} to {end}, except a fire heading your way.
strings.setup.community.title: Alerts from farmers nearby
strings.setup.community.why: Farmers can warn each other about pests, crop disease, fire, water problems and bad weather. Your name is never shown.
strings.setup.community.limit: Each farm can add up to 2 reports every 36 hours, so alerts stay useful. Saying "I'm seeing this too" does not count.
strings.setup.community.unverified: These are community reports and have not been independently checked.
strings.setup.help.title: Help while you learn
strings.setup.help.why: Drip and the "?" buttons explain things as you go. Switch them off once you know your way around.
strings.forgot.title: Forgot password
strings.forgot.intro: Enter the email you sign in with. We send a 6-digit code to your AgroFlow Telegram.
strings.forgot.badEmail: Enter the email address you sign in with.
strings.forgot.sent: If this account has Telegram linked, we've sent a code. It works for 10 minutes.
strings.forgot.noTelegram: No Telegram? Ask your AgroFlow field officer to reset it.
strings.forgot.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
strings.forgot.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
strings.signin.tempHint: Temporary passwords are 8 letters and numbers, like KX7P 4MRT. Spaces and small letters are fine. After 72 hours one stops working: use Forgot password, or ask your field officer.
strings.signin.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
strings.signin.notConfirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Please contact your field officer.
strings.signin.noConnection: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
strings.signin.badEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
strings.signin.title: Sign in
strings.signin.subtitle: Enter your AgroFlow account details.
strings.signin.askCall: Not a farmer on AgroFlow yet? Ask for a call
strings.onetap.failed: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Sign in with your temporary password instead.
strings.zone.noKit: No kit connected to this zone
strings.zone.kitOffline: No kit connected to this zone: its kit has not been heard from in the last 5 minutes. Check it has power and WiFi.
strings.zone.doWetDry: Teach the soil (wet/dry) to read this as moisture
strings.zone.liveCaption: From the zone's kit, and water use today.
strings.run.noResponse: Kit didn't respond — check it's online
strings.today.overLimit: Recommended {recommended} min — your pump is limited to {max} min per run; run it again after it finishes
strings.empty.noReading: Waiting for your kit's first reading

strings.irrigation.subtitle: Check and manage each zone.
strings.irrigation.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.
strings.irrigation.noZonesBody: Your field officer adds them; they will appear here.
strings.irrigation.manualMode: Manual: waters only when you start it
strings.drought.noBudget: Set up your tank to see how many days of water you have.
strings.community.title: Farmers nearby
strings.community.subtitle: Warn each other about pests, disease, fire, water and weather
strings.community.none: Nothing reported near your farm right now.
strings.community.downwind: The wind may be blowing this fire towards your farm. This is an estimate from the wind, not a prediction.
strings.community.similar: {n} nearby farms have reported something similar.
strings.community.alsoSeen: You said you are seeing this too.
strings.community.sub.possible_contamination: Water may be dirty or unsafe
strings.community.fire.pickDirection: Choose which way it is spreading.
strings.community.fire.closed: Thank you. The fire is marked as out and the report is closed.
strings.community.form.title: Report something near your farm
strings.community.form.note: A short note (you can leave this)
strings.community.form.place: The report uses your farm's saved place. Your phone's location is never used, and your name is never shown.
strings.community.form.fireDanger: If you're in danger, leave and call {call}.
strings.community.form.similar: Already reported nearby. If it is the same, say you are seeing it too (this does not use up a report):
strings.community.form.seeingTooThis: I'm seeing this too: {what}, about {km} km away
strings.community.form.sent: Thank you. Your report went to {n} farms nearby.

strings.sensor.noRefill: Log a refill to see the level

strings.usage.estimate: Estimated from run time and the zone's flow; there is no water meter.

strings.forecast.title: The week ahead
strings.forecast.noneBody: We get the weather for your area a few times a day. If this keeps saying the same thing, ask your field officer to check your farm's location.
strings.reports.loadFailed: Your reports could not be loaded.
strings.reports.makeFailed: This report could not be made. Try again later.
strings.reports.stopBody: You will stop getting reports on their own. You can still ask for one here any time, and your field officer can switch them back on.
strings.reports.title: Your reports
strings.reports.autoBody: These arrive on their own. You will also find them in the list below.
strings.reports.fromA11y: Start date, year dash month dash day
strings.reports.toA11y: End date, year dash month dash day
strings.reports.scheduleNoDates: The watering schedule always covers today and the week ahead, so there are no dates to choose.
strings.reports.pickOneZone: A soil moisture report is for one zone. Please pick one.
strings.reports.allZonesHint: All zones gives a short summary. Pick one zone for the full report, with charts and advice.
strings.reports.oneZoneHint: You will get the full report for this zone: charts, what the crop needed, and advice.
strings.reports.none: You have not asked for a report yet.
strings.reports.openFailed: This report could not be opened.

strings.profile.logOutBody: You will need to sign in again to use AgroFlow.

strings.setpw.linkExpired: This recovery link is invalid or has expired.
strings.setpw.linkUnverified: The password recovery link could not be checked.
strings.setpw.openValidLink: Open a valid password recovery link first.
strings.setpw.tooShort: Your new password must have at least 8 characters.

strings.setpw.title: Choose a new password
strings.setpw.doneBody: Your AgroFlow password has been changed.
strings.setpw.firstBody: The password you signed in with was a temporary one. Anyone who saw it, or who can scroll back through your Telegram chat, could use it, so please choose your own now.
strings.setpw.body: Enter and confirm the new password for your account.
strings.kit.noZone: This zone could not be found.
strings.kit.loadFailed: Your kit details could not be loaded.
strings.kit.changeBody: Your kit will forget its current WiFi and open its own setup network. Watering keeps running in the meantime.
strings.kit.unreachable: Your kit could not be reached.
strings.kit.title: Your kit
strings.kit.noneBody: This zone has no kit installed. Watering is set by hand until one is fitted.
strings.kit.onlineBody: Your kit is talking to us and your watering is running normally.
strings.kit.offlineBody: We have not heard from your kit recently. Check that it has power and that your WiFi is working.
strings.kit.airSensorNote: Not responding: using weather data instead. Your watering carries on as normal, because the soil sensor is what decides when to water.
strings.kit.soilSensorNote: Without the soil sensor your kit cannot decide when to water on its own. It keeps to its timetable, and you can still water by hand.
strings.kit.wifiWhen: Use this if you got a new router, or changed your WiFi name or password.
strings.kit.webNote: You are using AgroFlow in a browser. To finish a WiFi change you need the phone that will join your kit's setup network, so do this step on your phone.
strings.kit.offWifiNote: Your kit keeps watering on its own while it is off WiFi, using the last readings it took.
strings.kit.sheetIntro: Your kit has opened its own WiFi network. Three steps:
strings.kit.step1Join: On this phone, join the WiFi network
strings.kit.step2: A setup page opens. Choose your new WiFi and enter its password.
strings.kit.step3: Your kit reconnects by itself within a minute.
strings.kit.setupWindow: The setup network stays open for 5 minutes. If it closes before you get there, unplug and replug your kit 3 times quickly to open it again.
